comments.name: Global Nomad
comments.content: The Fed's dovish comments temporarily eased some market tension, but the underlying inflation pressure is still real. Seeing the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.3% is wild, definitely echoes the "taper tantrum" vibes from 2013, but perhaps with more structural issues this time. My US friends are also freaking out about their mortgages. On the bright side, Google Gemini's capabilities are mind-blowing, and Micron's long-term forecast for AI chips shows solid growth potential. It's a double-edged sword: AI is accelerating, creating new industries, but also posing questions about job displacement, even if Accenture's numbers are reassuring for now. The global economy is truly at a crossroads, quite a challenge for policymakers.
